segments.speaker: Participant

segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once my partner and the lieutenant were on the same page ... second-guessing a direction everybody had already settled into.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I treated the DNA gap as something forensics might still explain ... I kept him as primary.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The newest statement ... got the most space ... it was what was fresh in my head.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It usually teaches you to keep digging on alternatives even when the main line looks solid.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Probably would've split our attention from the start ... Coming in early and vague versus coming in late and sharp made a real difference.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Participant gives a substantive counterfactual prediction about information timing; no hidden bias is assigned.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Maybe assigning someone concretely to the rear-entrance lead right at the briefing ...
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Participant identifies a concrete process change in hindsight; no hidden bias is manifested in the proposed redo.

segments.speaker: Participant

segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive retrospective assessment and proposed procedural change, but no hidden bias is manifested.

instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic and Recency Effects are neighboring accessibility-based constructs, but the hidden target is specifically the disproportionate weighting caused by information recency; the RAG also names Recency effect only as an alternative label.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects all three positive segments with no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance precision, recall, and F1 are each 0.3333: Groupthink is exact, while the two correctly localized mechanism matches use near-neighbor labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, all three hidden mechanisms are correctly localized and detected, yielding mechanism-first precision, recall, and F1 of 1.0000.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The Anchoring bias candidate is a useful abstention in the analysis itself, but counting candidates as detections adds a false alarm because the localized segment is negative and no hidden anchoring instance exists.
main_failure_modes: Two full-mechanism detections use near-neighbor labels instead of the hidden target labels.

main_strengths: All three identified findings use valid transcript quotations.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment-level and mechanism-first detection at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, but only one of three exact label-plus-mechanism instance matches. The large taxonomy gap indicates that ontology alignment, rather than evidence localization or mechanism extraction, is the main limiting factor.
